events.title: General Mills Q1 Profit Plunges, Confirms FY27 Outlook
events.description: Branded consumer foods maker General Mills, Inc. reported Wednesday sharply lower profit in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, hurt by the absence of prior year's significant gain and weak net sales, both related to the sale of the U.S. yogurt business. Further, the firm maintained fiscal 2027 outlook.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises Amid Fed Rate Hike Speculation
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as the market's anticipation of additional Fed monetary tightening in the upcoming months and investors' confidence regarding the results of new efforts to establish a peace agreement with Iran.

events.title: UK Private Sector Growth Softens
events.description: The UK private sector growth moderated to a three-month low in September, reflecting a loss of momentum in manufacturing and service sectors, flash data from S&P Global showed Wednesday. The headline composite output index fell to 51.7 in September from 52.5 in August. This was the lowest since June and below forecast of 52.0.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: FTSE 100 Flat At Noon; Weak PMI Data Weighs
events.description: U.K. stocks turned in a mixed performance Wednesday morning as weak PMI data weighed on sentiment. Oil prices recovered from early lows, rendering the mood a bit cautious.

events.title: Eurozone Private Sector Growth Strongest Since Early 2023
events.description: The euro area private sector expanded at the fastest pace since April 2023 amid solid expansions in both the services and manufacturing sectors, survey data from S&P Global revealed Wednesday. The flash composite output index advanced to 53.1 in September from 52.0 in the prior month. The score was seen at 51.7.

events.title: Indian Shares End Modestly Higher As Brent Oil Falls Below $100
events.description: Indian shares ended modestly higher on Wednesday as investors kept a close eye on developments between the U.S. and Iran, and looked forward to a crucial U.S.-China summit on Thursday, which could lead to new trade agreements amid escalating competition and restrictions on advanced technologies.

events.title: Aussie Falls As Australia PMI Slows
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, following the disappointing release of flash PMIs, which revealed a slowdown in services activity and a contraction in the manufacturing sector.

events.title: CAC 40 Down Pares Early Gains, Down Slightly At Noon
events.description: French stocks gave up early gains slipped slightly below the flat line on Wednesday as the mood turned cautious despite flash survey data from S&P Global showing strong private sector activity in the month of September.

events.title: Gold Tumbles On Rate Hike Fears
events.description: Gold prices fell sharply on Wednesday as investors kept a close eye on developments between the U.S. and Iran, and looked forward to a crucial U.S.-China summit on Thursday, which could lead to new trade agreements amid escalating competition and restrictions on advanced technologies.

events.title: DAX Pares Early Gains, Down Nearly 0.5%; Auto Stocks Decline
events.description: German stocks pared early gains and slipped into negative territory Wednesday morning despite flash data showing the nation's private sector activity in September expanding at the fastest rate in over two years.

events.title: Oil Holds Steady After Recent Losses
events.description: Oil prices held steady on Wednesday after recent string of losses on hopes for progress in U.S.-Iran talks.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed Ahead Of Xi-Trump Summit
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Wednesday ahead of a high-stakes U.S.-China summit on Thursday, which could lead to new trade agreements amid escalating competition and restrictions on advanced technologies.
